answer: Require a refundable 12-unit stake locked for four epochs. Each identity submits fresh work and passes two independent reviews before its weight increases; three failed or copied submissions slash the stake. The prism ledger stores each proof, while opal reviewers verify execution and a willow-key signature binds the result to one account. Every extra fake identity therefore adds capital, lock time, and review risk, making a sybil farm unprofitable.
